title: ActionSendTextToContact
description: Sends a text message to the current contact.

route_id.description: ID of the route to send the message from. If not specified, uses the default route.

label_names.description: Array of label names to apply to the sent message.

schedule.description: Schedule to send the message at a later time.

on_click.description: Name of a subroutine (with context `message`) to run the first time the recipient clicks a link in the message. Requires `body.track_clicks`. Within the subroutine, [[$destination_url]] is the URL that was clicked.

on_click_timeout.description: Runs a subroutine (with context `message`) if the recipient has not clicked a link in the message within the specified time. Requires `body.track_clicks`.
